description.value: Takeya Sushi is a neighbourhood Japanese restaurant in Richmond that has been serving the community since 2000, offering an extensive menu of sushi rolls, nigiri, sashimi, bento boxes, rice bowls, noodles, and seasonal chef's specials. The kitchen highlights local BC seafood including wild sockeye and black cod. The restaurant currently operates as takeout only, with online pre-ordering available to skip the wait.

address.value: 8671 Number 1 Road, Unit 17, Richmond, BC V7C 1V2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at takeyasushi.ca is live with posts from January–February 2026, confirming an active business. Phone (604-448-5587) and address (8671 No 1 Rd #17) match OSM tags exactly, and the postal code V7C 1V2 is website-only. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the site; takeout-only status is explicitly stated on multiple pages, and gluten-free and vegetarian options are confirmed from the menu pages.
concerns: Restaurant is currently TAKE OUT ONLY — no dine-in service, so washroom access for customers is unconfirmed.
Minor internal inconsistency on website: about text reads 'Since 2000' while page title and copyright footer both read 'Since 2001'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active takeout sushi restaurant with broad menu appeal for cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) could be confirmed from the website, and the takeout-only model makes washroom access uncertain.

Takeout.detail: Website states 'We are currently accepting TAKE OUT ONLY' on multiple pages; online ordering and SkipTheDishes delivery both available

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes vegetarian items (edamame, vegetable miso soup, gomaae, vegetable sunomono, green salad, vegetable croquette). Beef Teriyaki Roll notes 'Gluten Free Available'. No explicit vegan labelling found
